rules.title: Assignment to innerHTML/outerHTML
rules.description: Writing to innerHTML parses the string as HTML. Any attacker-controlled substring can introduce a script-executing element such as .
rules.remediation: Use textContent for text. If you must render HTML, run it through DOMPurify.sanitize() first.

rules.title: document.write() with a dynamic value
rules.description: document.write() injects into the parser stream, so it executes scripts and cannot be sanitized after the fact.
rules.remediation: Build nodes with createElement/textContent and append them.

rules.title: dangerouslySetInnerHTML
rules.description: React escapes by default; this prop opts out of that for the value it is given.
rules.remediation: Sanitize with DOMPurify before passing, or render as children so React escapes it.

rules.title: jQuery .html()/.append() with a dynamic value
rules.description: jQuery's HTML-inserting methods parse and execute scripts in the string they are given.
rules.remediation: Use .text() for text content, or sanitize the HTML first.

rules.title: URL fragment or query string flowing into the DOM
rules.description: This is the shape of a DOM XSS: an attacker-controlled part of the URL reaches an HTML sink without escaping.
rules.remediation: Treat every part of location as untrusted input; encode it for the context you are writing into.

rules.title: mark_safe()/|safe on a runtime value
rules.description: mark_safe tells Django's autoescaper this string is already safe. On a runtime value that assertion is usually false.
rules.remediation: Escape the dynamic parts with format_html() and keep only the static markup marked safe.

rules.title: Markup()/Jinja autoescape disabled
rules.description: Markup() marks a string as trusted HTML; disabling autoescape does it for a whole template.
rules.remediation: Leave autoescape on and pass values as context variables.

rules.title: v-html directive
rules.description: v-html renders raw HTML, bypassing Vue's escaping.
rules.remediation: Use {{ }} interpolation, or sanitize before binding.

rules.title: insertAdjacentHTML with a dynamic value
rules.description: insertAdjacentHTML parses its second argument as HTML, exactly like innerHTML. Anything an attacker controls in that string can introduce a script-executing element, and sanitizing afterwards is too late.
rules.remediation: Build the node explicitly or sanitize the markup.

rules.title: Request value echoed without escaping
rules.description: Superglobal data echoed into the response body is reflected XSS.

rules.title: Template engine configured without autoescaping
rules.description: Turning autoescaping off makes every interpolation a potential XSS sink.
rules.remediation: Leave autoescaping on and mark the few genuinely-static HTML strings safe individually.
